object.name: evi_control_lpg_buchla
object.digest: Envelope and control circuit wrapper for voltage control of Rf
object.description: Analog modelled vactrol envelope and control circuit for the voltage control of the <o>evi_lpg_buchla</o>.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction <o>evi.lpg~</o>.

constructor.inlets: ping, vactrol, vactrol, offset, scale, sweep

inlets.name: ping
inlets.digest: Ping the control circuit. Once connected to an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) audio rate ping to attack the filter gate.

inlets.name: vactrol
inlets.digest: Ping attack time in ms. Because this is an analog modelled vactrol, the attack time has a strong affect on envelope range and sweep. Slower attack times may silence the control circuit alltogether if @vactrolscalar or the three control inlets are set to low values.

inlets.name: vactrol
inlets.digest: Ping decay time in ms. This refers to the voltage release time. The audible decay of the control circuit is longer.

inlets.name: offset
inlets.digest: 0..1 Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: scale
inlets.digest: 0..1 Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: sweep
inlets.digest: 0..1 Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

outlets.name: r_f
outlets.digest: Rf (frequency) voltage, typically to trigger an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) downstream.

outlets.name: vactrol
outlets.digest: Aux output of the initial envelope follower that begins the ping of the control circuit (LPG). Can be useful for synchronous downstream processing.

attributes.name: offsetsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: override
attributes.description: A special option that simplifies the LPG interaction. If set to on (1) the vactrol envelope controls all 'control inlets' (inlets 4, 5 and 6). This forces a classic LPG sound in a simple way. Typically, when using this feature, one would switch inlets 4, 5 and 6 to zero and control the circuit only via the rise/fall inlets and vactrol attributes. However, the vactrol 'override' control is summed with the control inlets, so interesting effects can be achieved by utilising 'scale' (inlet 5) and 'sweep' (inlet 6) simultaneously (but 'offset' - inlet 4 - should be zero with the 'override' feature on). If @override is off (the default), the LPG behaves as normal, with the control inlets only tuned by the values at their inputs.

attributes.name: response
attributes.description: Select 0, 1, 2. Subtle. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper. It is only noticeable with high control (and filter resonance) settings

attributes.name: scalesmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 5) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: sweepsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 6) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: vactrolcontroldamp
attributes.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Under the right settings, this attribute can have a strong affect on the attack feeling of the gate voltage. A higher damping value 'softens' the attack at the filter stage rather than in the envelope stage. This can add a squidgy sound the is rather cool. The mapping filter frequency is set by the @vactrolcontrolhz attribute.

attributes.name: vactrolcontrolhz
attributes.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). Typically this would be set to low Hz values (perhaps 5..20) for maximum effect. This filter mapping is controlled by the @vactrolcontroldamp attribute and is by default off.

attributes.name: vactrolscalar
attributes.description: Scale the output amplitude of the vactrol envelope at the beginning of the ping chain. Very different behaviours can be achieved by modifying this in combination with careful tuning if the Rise/Fall controls (inlets 2 and 3). Scaling behaviour is also achieved with the 'Offset', 'Scale' and 'Sweep' controls (inlets 4, 5 and 6). However, it is possible to keep those control values low and this attribute high to achieve a different sort of LPG effect. This attribute also requires high settings when using the @override attribute feature.

attributes.name: vactrolshape
attributes.description: Transform the vactrol envelope shape between flat ('0') and sharp ('1'). This has a radical affect on the sound of the ping. Higher values also accentuate the attack stage and increase the amplitude of the envelope hitting the LPG.
